label: Time series
desc: Each row is a point in time, in days from the patient’s initial gamma knife radiosurgery: medication changes, imaging with references to raw files, procedures, follow-up visits and outcomes.
rows: Randomly generated 8-digit identifier unique to each patient
Type of event this row records
1 Medication · 2 Gamma Knife · 3 Image · 4 Follow Up · 5 Death
Time indexed from initial gamma knife procedure, in days
Time indexed from primary cancer diagnosis, in days
10-digit identifier for each cranial imaging study, linked to the imaging dataset
Volume in cm³ of all gamma knife targets from this procedure
Margin dose in Gy of the largest target in this plan
Tumor response of the largest tumor by MacDonald criteria
Cause of death, if the patient died

label: Individual
desc: Each row is one patient, with demographic details, cancer history, presenting symptoms, neurologic exam at first evaluation and summary outcomes.
rows: Randomly generated 8-digit identifier unique to each patient
Extent of disease at initial gamma knife evaluation
Number of intracranial metastases at initial evaluation
Total follow-up in days from initial gamma knife
Days from initial gamma knife until death

label: Gamma Knife details
desc: Each row is one gamma knife target, giving per-target detail for the radiosurgery plans in the time series.
rows: 9-digit identifier unique to each gamma knife procedure
Count of targets indexed from 1, per plan
Whether this is the plan’s largest target
Volume of outlined target in cm³
Paddick Conformity Index of the target
Volume of tissue in cm³ receiving 12 Gy

label: Imaging metadata
desc: Each row is a point in time with cranial imaging, keyed to the time series by image_id.
rows: 10-digit identifier unique to each cranial imaging study
Count of imaging events indexed from 1, per patient
